gloss: to look out over; to survey; to scan

definitions.gloss: to look out over; to survey; to take in a view
definitions.explanation: To look across a wide area, typically from an elevated position.
To look around an area comprehensively, often to find or check something.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{上|うえ}から{町|まち}を{見渡|みわた}した。
examples.english: I looked out over the town from the top of the mountain.

examples.japanese: {見渡|みわた}す{限|かぎ}り{海|うみ}が{広|ひろ}がっていた。
examples.english: As far as the eye could see, the ocean stretched out.
examples.notes: {見渡|みわた}す{限|かぎ}り = as far as one can see

examples.japanese: {展望台|てんぼうだい}から{街|まち}を{見渡|みわた}すと、{遠|とお}くに{富士山|ふじさん}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: When I looked out over the city from the observation deck, I could see Mt. Fuji in the distance.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}を{見渡|みわた}して、{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}がないか{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I looked around the room to check if I'd forgotten anything.

examples.japanese: {教室|きょうしつ}を{見渡|みわた}したが、{彼|かれ}の{姿|すがた}はなかった。
examples.english: I scanned the classroom, but he wasn't there.

examples.japanese: {会議室|かいぎしつ}に{入|はい}って{全体|ぜんたい}を{見渡|みわた}すと、もう{全員|ぜんいん}{席|せき}に{着|つ}いていた。
examples.english: When I entered the meeting room and looked around, everyone was already seated.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
Pattern: [place]を{見渡|みわた}す

ASPECT:
{見渡|みわた}している indicates ongoing surveying or a resulting state of having surveyed.

CONJUGATION:
・{見渡|みわた}さない (negative)
・{見渡|みわた}して (te-form)
・{見渡|みわた}した (past)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{見渡|みわた}す{限|かぎ}り - as far as the eye can see
・{周囲|しゅうい}を{見渡|みわた}す - to look around
・{会場|かいじょう}を{見渡|みわた}す - to scan the venue
・{街|まち}を{見渡|みわた}す - to overlook the town

COMPOUND VERB:
{見|み} (see) + {渡|わた}す (to cross over) → to look across
